claims.text: A machine learning-based interatomic potential can calculate the melting temperature of high-melting refractory materials.
A machine learning-based interatomic potential can calculate the entropy of fusion of high-melting refractory materials.
A machine learning-based interatomic potential can calculate the enthalpy of fusion of high-melting refractory materials.
A machine learning-based interatomic potential can calculate the volume change of high-melting refractory materials at the melting point.
The machine learning-based interatomic potential significantly reduces computational cost relative to traditional DFT-based ab initio free-energy approaches.
The machine learning-based interatomic potential accurately predicts melting properties.
Machine learning-based prediction is the mechanism by which the interatomic potential yields melting-property estimates.
